name: Galactic Union
promotion_note: World Bible dual-source; primary GU polity. CANON.

substructure_reconciliation.note: GUMAS_Factions.json names the Galactic Union's substructures (Union Intelligence, Union Marshals, Diplomatic Corps, Sentinels). Each already has its own committed entity record; this pass cross-links them via organization_ids. Additive only — no new entities, no invented detail.
substructure_reconciliation.source_ref: archives/session_archives/AU_Archive_327-330/GUMAS_Factions.json (Galactic Union: substructures [Union Intelligence, Union Marshals, Diplomatic Corps, Sentinels])

government.form: Federal, multi-species democracy — power is balanced among planets, regions and species.
government.principle: A balance between centralized federal power and planetary autonomy: order without fully suppressing local governance.
government.legal_framework: Built on interstellar treaties, regional authority and centralized oversight.

charter.name: Galactic Union Charter
charter.content: Formalized the principles of governance, trade regulation and conflict resolution.
charter.status: Attested in early-project canon prose; no separate charter document record exists in CanonRec.

government.basis: Recovered from early-project prose claims. Checked first against canon: no existing record carried the Union's constitutional basis — org_galactic_union had no government field at all. Non-conflicting discovered detail, reconciled per the standing rule.

lingua_franca.name: Union Standard Galactic (USG)
lingua_franca.role: The common trade and diplomatic language of the Union.
lingua_franca.limit: Local dialects and cultural traditions persist alongside it — a shared language of exchange rather than an imposed monoculture.
lingua_franca.record_form: Recorded inline rather than minted: canon has no "language" entity kind, and the same treatment is used for offices, which are described in place.
lingua_franca.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Outer Colonies frontier character — 2026-08-15

origin.founding_purpose: Founded as a defensive alliance intended to prevent another full-scale galactic collapse.
origin.membership_caveat: The source marks this list APPROX and states membership lists are contested. A second passage names the same participants more loosely — "post-imperial Velar polity, Nythran, Zyphari blocs, and Harkon successors". Recorded as attested-and-contested, not as a settled founding roster.
origin.name_forms_in_source: "Zyphari Trade Compact" and "Velar Republic (post-Imperium)" are source forms; canon carries polity_zyphari_compact (Zyphari Compact) and polity_velar_imperium. Whether these are the same bodies under era-specific names is not established here and no binding is asserted.
origin.later_development: Source describes a subsequent Stabilization & Expansion phase in which the charter was formalized and the Marshals Division established — also marked APPROX.
origin.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Nythran pair + Union founding, 2026-08-27
